Subject: POC capacity planning - Acme AI (reserved GPUs + autoscale)

Hi Alice / Raj —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. As discussed, attaching a short POC capacity worksheet (see attachment) to capture the evaluation plan, success criteria, timeline, and recommended capacity for a 4-week proof-of-concept. High level recap below and a few asks to finalize scheduling: 

Summary / success criteria (from call)
- Integrations: LLM inference via Redwood API to power real-time chat & batch summarization jobs.
- Quality: >= 92% on the intent/accuracy eval set you shared.
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 300ms for 1k token context (real-time flows).
- Cost target: <= $0.018 per 1k tokens during POC (TBD with model/quantization).

POC evaluation plan / ownership
- Acme: provide eval prompt set + 2 weeks of traffic replay (Raj).
- Redwood: stand up dedicated POC cluster, implement prefix caching and batching for RAG flows (Marissa / Marcus).
- Success check: joint eval at week 3 to confirm quality/latency before rolling to week 4.

Capacity asks (need answers from infra to size POC)
1) Expected concurrent real-time users (p95 concurrency) and QPS per user.
2) Peak batch summarization throughput (docs/minute) and preferred schedule for bursts.
3) Any strict IP/networking constraints for Private deployment?

Proposed initial capacity (subject to your answers):
- Reserved: 2x A10G instances (or equivalent 48GB GPU) for predictable latency on real-time flows.
- Autoscale: allow 3x burst capacity via dynamic cluster autoscaling up to 6 GPUs (30 minute warmup policy).

Please review the attachment and reply with the concurrency/QPS numbers and preferred POC start window (we have availability starting Aug 24).

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0157

Hi Marissa / Dylan —

Thanks for the recap and the sheet. Quick answers below to help size the POC: 

Traffic / concurrency
- Real-time chat: 120 active demo users expected during peak with an average of 0.2 QPS per active user (so ~24 QPS steady), but we expect short bursts up to ~75 QPS (1-2 minute spikes) during product marketing tests.
- Batch summarization: ~3k docs/hour during peak ingest windows (we can shift heavy reruns to off-peak if helpful).

Evaluation timeline
- We aim to start POC the week of Aug 24, 2026 and run 4 full weeks.
- Deliverables: weekly syncs (Mon 11am PT), mid-poc quality checkpoint at week 3.

Success criteria (confirming what was discussed)
- Accuracy >= 92% on provided eval set.
- p95 latency < 350ms (we can be flexible +/- 50ms if cost delta is significant).

Network / ownership
- Infra: Raj will own whitelisting and test accounts (cc’ed).
- We have an existing VPC peering setup for partner POCs — our infra will confirm if that’s preferred or if public TLS endpoints are easier.

Attachments: I’ve uploaded a traffic replay sample to the shared Drive link in your sheet.

Let us know if the proposed reserved 2x A10G + 3x burst up to 6 GPUs looks OK — otherwise suggest an alternate baseline.

Best,
Alice Chen
Head of Product | Acme AI
alice@acme-ai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@acme-ai.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme-ai.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC capacity planning - Acme AI (reserved GPUs + autoscale)

Perfect — thanks for the details, Alice. Based on your numbers the recommended POC config is below. I’ve attached a one-page summary and the updated capacity sheet.

Redwood recommended POC capacity (final proposal)
- Baseline reserved: 2x A10G-equivalent GPUs dedicated to your POC (predictable latency for real-time).
- Autoscaling/burst: allow scaling up to 6 GPUs for short bursts. Autoscaler policy: target CPU/GPU utilization 65% with scale-up faster (5 min) and scale-down conservative (30 min) to avoid thrash.
- Batching/caching: enable KV prefix caching for RAG flows; micro-batching for chat to keep p95 < 350ms.
- Cost note: with reserved pricing + autoscale cap the projected POC monthly-equivalent spend is ~$9k (4-week run pro-rated), final number depends on model selection and quantization.

POC milestones / owners
- Aug 24: POC kickoff (Marissa / Raj) — infra verification and whitelisting.
- Week 1: smoke tests with 10 demo users + initial replay.
- Week 3: mid-poc quality check (joint evaluation).
- Week 4: final metrics and next-steps discussion (expand to Dedicated / Reserved commit).

Action items for Acme (please confirm by EOD Wed Aug 19)
- Confirm POC start date (we suggested Aug 24).
- Confirm whether VPC peering or public TLS endpoints (Raj).
- Provide final eval set and any additional replay windows.

If that all looks good I’ll put together an SOW addendum with the reserved capacity and proposed billing terms (short POC pricing + option to convert to a 6-12 month reserved commit).

Thanks —
Marissa
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
